# SuperCPN weather-routing core

The files under `include/supercpn/weather_routing` and
`src/engine/native` are derived from the SuperCPN weather-routing core:

- Project: SuperCPN
- Source: https://github.com/pob220/SuperCPN
- Imported revision: `cd263ab8e183e79cf78a9fcc9862773e04f4a336`

licence notice is retained here and in the source history.
